Le Bambino Danang
Jun 2026 • Solo
Shop is in an alley. Not difficult to find. Nearby crowne hotel.

Service: very good
Ambience: Very good.
Decor: Simple yet interesting. 
Food:
Had french onion soup, goat cheese salad, duck confit and crep with cointreau flame.

Onion soup taste: average as it lacks the intense tastes of long fried onions. Colour was a bit on the pale side. The bread biscuit is better than croutons and goes well with the soup.

Goat cheese salad: average as the goat cheese aroma was not strong enough. It was kinda toasted atop a biscuit bread. The pears in the salad seemed to be a canned product so this is iff.

Duck confit: first bite was a little tough and throughout felt too salty. Next table to me also had duck confit and they also commented about the salt content being too high. Came with mashed potatoes….baked potatoes was featured on their website.

Crepe with countreau: instagrammable. Generous drop of liquer while the crepe was a but hard. And i was given a soda spoon to eat with the crepe….had to request for a fork and knife. Vanilla ice cream inside was just sweet.

Presentation of food was simple and nice. Oh and wine was fine too and they served french wines.

My rating of four star and not lower is partly because of the price being reasonable to the food tastes. Had an enjoyable meal overall.

Time for a refurbishment
Mar 2023
This is a nice restaurant, and I bet it was once "top of the town".
You can see from the overall layout and menu that this establishment has seen better days.
It is still quite a nice restaurant and the food is tasty, but it is not a five-star restaurant. The problem is that it charges $$$$ like one.
There is an old saying " If you are not moving forwards, then you're going backward". This is very true of this restaurant, all the glassware and ornaments need cleaning or replacements. The bathroom is old and manky, not what you would consider acceptable.
It would be great to see this place do a renovation, and spend some money on upgrades..
The broccoli did not appear to be fresh, which bothered me considering there are fresh vegetables everywhere in Vietnam.
The redeeming feature was the prawns, they were excellent, 
but the blue cheese sauce was too thin and runny.
I would have given 4 out of 5. But because the bathroom is manky and the price is too high for what you get, I dropped it to a three.

FINE FRENCH FOOD (3F) ABOVE EXPECTATIONS
Jan 2023 • Friends
Our G4Fun went to Le Bambino for French food following recommendations from the local travel agent. There were about 20 of us. We ordered food for sharing for the majority. The 3 items for dinner of the night were french lobster soup,ravioli lobster and rib eye of 700 gm meant for two. Most of us took the three special items of the night. I elected to try out the most expensive item on their list of typical french food. The listed item was not specific,something like Chilean white fish and fresh foie grass. My guess was the fish is cod from the Patagonia region of Chile. That was correct. The cod was fresh. The fresh foie gras was very well done with a little bit of redness. The first time after many years eating fresh foie gras outside France. We were unanimous in giving our thumbs up to the French food.
